issues.title: Background/resize/peak selection/chunk effects remain confounded
issues.status: Implementation differences proven; accuracy causes unmeasured.
issues.evidence: INTER_AREA differs from referencePIL; rolling per-shot median differs from fixed/rally median; global-max component lacks multi-hypothesis association. VOD effective 60 differs from profile 64, causing step 8 tail overlap. Both step 8/4 remove static T accepted peaks under fixed background/180 frame context; cannot credit step 4.
issues.next_action: Separate background-only, resize-only, context-only and temporal association trials; use factorials for interactions. Pin images/masks/checkpoint/precision; compare localization only with labels and downstream intervals separately.
issues.controls: Step 8 emits every frame; not seven-of-eight skipping. Missing an old distractor is not recovered correct shuttle localization.

issues.evidence: ratio=post/max(pre,1e−6), rejection only if both speeds<.5. GT27 contact 12748: .0228→1.1602 px/frame, redirect 1,impulse 1, proximity.0656,score.7297. Controlled 2.4 px turn near 100 px body yields.977989 without pose/racket; not a human-labeled false hit.
issues.next_action: Expose velocity reliability; compare absolute motion/acceleration against relative ratio in opt-in contact provider. Review contact timing before calibration or weight changes; isolate from segmentation.
issues.controls: Blunt incoming-speed floor suppresses valid low-speed serve launches. Include apexes, quantization, occlusion and boundary hits.
